Messages.Author: Aerchangelus
Messages.Body:
In our playgroup, a question about this card arose yesterday:
Is there any limit to the number of cards that Maabara can have on it?. I mean: you can have only one card in storage in this card or any number of them?.
And a question in general: in cards that can be employed to store others cards (like this, for example) if there is no specific rule in the card to limit the nunber to one card (as in Storage Annex), can you store any number of cards in them or you are limited to one UNLESS it is specified in the card text?.

Maabara
Master

[Harbinger of Skulls] Harbinger of Skulls

Master: unique location.
You may tap this location to move a library card from your ash heap to this location, face down. You may use a master phase action to move a card from this location to the top of your library. Any vampire may burn this location as a  action.

Artist(s): Eric Lofgren

Set(s): LoB:R

Thank you in advance

Messages.Author: derjudge
Messages.Body: Yes, 89. (or 90, if you control maabara after stealing it)

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
the limit is the number of cards it would take to make the playing table buckle and collapse under the combined weight

if you're playing VTES on the ground, assume the entire Earth to be your table, and try not to collapse it.
